She is first seen with [[Bryony]] and one of the {{tc|Team Flare Admin}}s at the [[Poké Ball Factory]], trying to coerce the company president into working for them. The player, along with {{ga|Calem}}/{{ga|Serena}}, will face the two scientists in a [[Multi Battle]]. She is met again at [[Lysandre Labs]], preparing for Team Flare's plan to use the [[ultimate weapon]]. ===Pokémon=== ===={{g|X and Y}}==== =====First battle ([[Multi Battle]] with [[Bryony]])===== {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Celosia anime.png|thumb|200px|Celosia in {{aniseries|XY}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== In the past, Celosia, alongside [[Lysandre]] and the other [[Team Flare]] Scientists, would help those in need, until Lysandre became disillusioned with the [[human]] race and sought to restart the world. Celosia debuted in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]''. She was first seen leading a group of {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s to recapture the {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde Core}} that had [[XYS04|escaped]] from [[Lysandre Labs]]. She managed to find the {{p|Zygarde}} Core, but thanks to {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and [[Sawyer]]'s interference, she was unable to retrieve it. When she later informed [[Xerosic]] of what had happened, she was told that [[Bryony]] had been tasked with capturing [[Squishy|the Core]] as well. During the following night, Celosia led yet another group of Grunts in an attempt to capture the Core, but with Ash and Sawyer covering {{an|Serena}}, {{an|Clemont}}, and {{an|Bonnie}}'s retreat, she was once again unsuccessful. [[File:Team Flare Scientists Young.png|thumb|left|250px|A younger Celosia (far right)]] In ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'', Celosia teamed up with Bryony to retrieve the Core (now called Squishy by Bonnie) in [[Terminus Cave]]. After a prolonged struggle, during which {{TRT}} interfered as well, Team Flare was forced to retreat, as they were unable to defeat [[Ash's Greninja]] and Squishy had fled. In the [[XY103|next episode]], she, along with Bryony and several Grunts, monitored sensors to find Squishy. Celosia and Bryony also ordered two Grunts to watch Ash and his friends. Later, the sensors caught energy waves coming from Squishy and [[Z2]], and managed to determine Squishy's location. However, they were unable to make it in time and lost sight of Squishy, as it had stopped emitting energy waves. Celosia and Bryony then ordered the pursuit squad to withdraw, as they thought Squishy probably wouldn't return to Ash and his friends, and decided to narrow their search. In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', during Team Flare's attack on [[Lumiose City]], Celosia appeared before Ash and [[Alain]]. Celosia revealed she was ordered to capture Ash and told him about Alain's affiliation with Team Flare. She then had her Drapion use {{m|Confuse Ray}} on Ash and {{AP|Pikachu}}, making them lose consciousness, allowing Team Flare to capture them. In [[XY133|the following episode]], Celosia was seen at Lysandre Labs with [[Mable]], where the two saw the helicopter, containing Serena, [[Mairin]], [[Professor Sycamore]], and Team Rocket, nearing their hideout through their security cameras. Upon the infiltration of their base, in [[XY134|the next episode]], Celosia went to stop Serena and the rest. She and her Drapion then faced Team Rocket in battle. Celosia continued battling in ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'' and was now joined by Mable and her {{p|Weavile}}. However, the two Scientists were quickly defeated and subdued in Team Rocket's net trap. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Celosia |pkmn=Drapion |type1=Poison |type2=Dark |img=Celosia Drapion.png |epnum=XY094 |epname=From A to Z! |desc={{p|Drapion}} first appeared in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]'', where Celosia used it to battle against {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} twice while trying to capture the {{p|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Core}}. It reappeared in ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'', where it attacked Ash and his friends and battled [[Ash's Noibat]]. However, it was stunned by {{m|Supersonic}} and then knocked back by {{m|Tackle}}. It was then aided by [[Bryony]]'s {{p|Bisharp}}. Drapion was eventually defeated by [[Squishy]], after it transformed to its 10% Forme. Drapion appeared once again in ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', during Team Flare's takeover of [[Lumiose City]]. It attacked Ash and [[Alain]], while they were attempting to rescue [[Mairin]], and incapacitated Ash and {{AP|Pikachu}} so that they could be captured. In ''[[XY134|The Right Hero for the Right Job!]]'', Celosia used Drapion to attack {{an|Serena}}, {{TRT}}, [[Mairin]], and [[Professor Sycamore]] after they infiltrated [[Lysandre Labs]]. Drapion then had to face Team Rocket's {{TP|Jessie|Gourgeist}} and {{TP|James|Inkay}}. It continued the battle in [[XY135|the following episode]] and was now aided by [[Mable]]'s {{p|Weavile}}. The two Pokémon attacks, however, were countered by [[Jessie's Wobbuffet]] using {{m|Mirror Coat}}. Drapion, Weavile, and their Trainers were then subdued by Team Rocket's net. Drapion's known moves are {{m|Pin Missile}}, {{m|Toxic}}, {{m|Sludge Bomb}}, {{m|Cross Poison}}, and {{m|Confuse Ray}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Celosia |pkmn=Manectric |type1=Electric |img=Celosia Manectric.png |epnum=XY102 |epname=Meeting at Terminus Cave! |vajp=Kenta Miyake |vaen=Jake Paque |desc={{p|Manectric}} appeared in ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'', where it was sent out to pursue [[Squishy]], alongside [[Bryony]]'s {{p|Liepard}}. It was stopped in its tracks by [[Ash's Pikachu]] and {{AP|Greninja}}. It managed to hit Greninja with a Thunderbolt while Greninja was battling Liepard, but after Greninja transformed to its Ash-Greninja Form, it was quickly beaten back. It then used Flash to allow [[Team Flare]] to escape. Manectric's known moves are {{m|Thunderbolt}}, {{m|Shock Wave}}, {{m|Scratch}}{{tt|*|Japanese version only, Manectric cannot legally learn Scratch in the games}}, and {{m|Flash}}.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{fire color light}}|bordercolor={{fire color dark}} |ja=奈波果林 ''[[Karin Nanami]]'' |en=[[Rebecca Soler|Jessica Paquet]] |fr_eu=Laetitia Liénart |pl=Katarzyna Sawczuk |pt_br=Carol Crespo |es_eu=Sara Heras |es_la=Fernanda Robles}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Team Flare Scientists Adventures.png|thumb|right|270px|Celosia in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Celosia disguise Adventures.png|thumb|left|170px|Celosia disguised as a Furfrou trimmer]] Celosia debuted in ''[[PS550|X-actly What They Wanted]]''. She, [[Bryony]], and [[Xerosic]] were first seen watching the destruction of [[Vaniville Town]] caused by the battle between {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}}. In ''[[PS554|Kangaskhan...Kangascan't]]'', Celosia approached {{adv|Shauna}} while disguised as a {{p|Furfrou}} stylist. She tricked Shauna into trimming a Furfrou illusion and handed the girl a {{p|Honedge}}, claiming it was a tool used by novices. Honedge took control of Shauna, putting her under mind control. Later that night, Celosia had the possessed Shauna steal the [[Kangaskhanite]] belonging to {{adv|X}}'s [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]]. With help from [[Korrina]], another user of [[Mega Evolution]], X retrieved the [[Mega Stone]], enabling him to Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga. Concluding that she had no chance of defeating two Mega Evolution users, Celosia decided the best option was to run away. In ''[[PS572|Shooting Frogadier]]'', Celosia met with [[Malva]] on {{rt|9|Kalos}}. They discussed a plan to mind control kidnapped Vaniville Town residents and have them transport the dormant tree form of Xerneas to the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]]. While separated from her friends, {{adv|Y}} accidentally walked into the area, allowing her to eavesdrop on the conversation and learn of Team Flare's scheme. Sensing Y's presence, Celosia tried attacking her with Honedge, but only managed to cut off a chunk of Y's hair after she was saved by her {{p|Froakie}}, [[Croaky]]. By evolving into a {{p|Frogadier}} and startling a herd of wild {{p|Rhyhorn}}, Croaky convinced Celosia that no one else was there. Later, Celosia returned to the Secret HQ, where she had Aegislash take control of the Vanville residents. In ''[[PS574|Tying Trevenant]]'', Celosia and [[Emma|Essentia]] arrived at {{rt|8|Kalos}}, where the operation to move Xerneas began. Upon noticing a piece of Y's hair stuck to her Honedge's sash, Celosia realized that someone was spying on her and Malva. Recognizing the hair as her daughter's, {{kal|Grace}} tried taking it from Celosia, only to be knocked to the ground. Seeing her mother in danger, Y and her friends immediately leapt in to stop Team Flare. X attempted to Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga and [[Élec]] at the same time, but failed, giving Essentia the chance to capture everyone with her {{p|Trevenant}}. Celosia tried to kill X, but was stopped by the timely arrival of Korrina, [[Diantha]], and [[Gurkinn]]. In ''[[PS575|Changing Gengar]]'', Celosia was tasked with getting Xerneas to the base while Malva and Essentia fought the heroes. Along the way, Celosia was attacked by Korrina and her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}}. Though it fainted in the process, Lucario managed to take down both Celosia and her Aegislash while freeing the townspeople from Aegislash's control. As she stood victorious, Korrina failed to notice Celosia's Honedge sneaking up behind her to launch a sneak attack. Korrina was knocked out, allowing Celosia to continue her mission to transport Xerneas. Before she left, Celosia stole Korrina's Key Stone, which was later given to Malva, who fastened it into a Mega Ring for [[Lysandre]] to use. In ''[[PS578|Gyarados Changes]]'', Celosia and the other female scientists watched as X tried to infiltrate the Team Flare Secret HQ. Noting Celosia's continued usage of Aegislash had left her mentally unstable, Bryony knocked Celosia unconscious to prevent her from losing control of herself. In ''[[PS589|Charizard Transforms]]'', Celosia and the other female scientists each intercepted Y and her friends to prevent them from reaching the [[Pokémon Village]]. Celosia picked Shauna as her opponent. Later, Shauna's {{p|Skitty|Kitty}} managed to take down Celosia's {{p|Doublade}}. Celosia tried to influence Shauna with Aegislash again, only for Korrina's Lucario to appear, revealing it was keeping Shauna safe with its [[Aura]]. Shauna then commanded Lucario to attack Celosia, defeating her and avenging Korrina at the same time. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{anchor|Manectric 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Celosia |pkmn=Manectric |type1=Electric |img=Bryony Liepard Adventures.png |epnum=PS550 |epname=X-actly What They Wanted |desc={{p|Manectric}} is Celosia's first known Pokémon.
